SASBDB entry SASDB48  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDB48/)

Publication: The herpes viral transcription factor ICP4 forms a novel DNA recognition complex.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkx419

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDB48/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
